name: Southern Cross Credit Union (SCCU)

maxLvrOwnerOccupiedPct.sourceTitle: SCCU — Owner Occupied Home Loans, Rates & Features
maxLvrOwnerOccupiedPct.note: Maximum LVR 95% with LMI. The professionals' section reads "eligible applicants on the professionals list for loans with 80-95% LVR", confirming the 95% ceiling. asAt is the retrieval date — the page carries no publication date (footer shows © 2026).

maxLvrNoLmiPct.sourceTitle: SCCU — Owner Occupied Home Loans, Rates & Features
maxLvrNoLmiPct.note: LMI applies above 80% LVR except for eligible professionals (waived to 90%) or where an acceptable guarantor or the Australian Government 5% Deposit Scheme applies.

value: Medical and health professionals registered with AHPRA
Legal professionals holding a current practising certificate
Finance professionals registered with eligible institutes
lmiWaiverProfessions.sourceTitle: SCCU — Owner Occupied Home Loans, Rates & Features
lmiWaiverProfessions.note: SCCU publishes a 'professionals list' rather than naming individual occupations; the three categories above are the groupings shown on the page. The specific eligible occupations/institutes are not published. asAt is the retrieval date.

lmiWaiverMaxLvrPct.sourceTitle: SCCU — Owner Occupied Home Loans, Rates & Features
lmiWaiverMaxLvrPct.note: "these professionals will receive an LMI waiver for loans up to 90% LVR". Eligible professionals also get a rate concession on 80–95% LVR loans.

notes.value: Must provide sufficient security in accordance with SCCU's credit assessment criteria — an acceptable residential mortgage, or a guarantor providing additional security. Building insurance is required with SCCU noted as an interested party for at least the building value. No property-type, unit-size, postcode, high-density, rural or land-size policy published.
notes.sourceTitle: SCCU Premium Variable Rate Home Loan TMD v6.0, issued 2 March 2026

minLoanAmount.sourceTitle: SCCU Premium Variable Rate Home Loan TMD v6.0, issued 2 March 2026
minLoanAmount.note: Under Financial Situation the TMD says the target market "Can chose [sic] a loan amount over $250,000". Read as the effective minimum for the Premium Variable Rate Home Loan; other SCCU loan products (line of credit, bridging, reverse mortgage) have their own TMDs and were not read.

maxLoanTermYears.sourceTitle: SCCU Premium Variable Rate Home Loan TMD v6.0, issued 2 March 2026
maxLoanTermYears.note: "repayments that can vary over the life of the loan (loan terms up to 40 years)". Confirmed on the owner-occupied product page ("up to 40 years"). A 40-year term is unusual and materially lifts servicing capacity.

offsetAvailable.sourceTitle: SCCU Premium Variable Rate Home Loan TMD v6.0, issued 2 March 2026
offsetAvailable.note: "This home loan can be linked to up to 8 Easy Access accounts, the balance of which will reduce the loan balance on which interest is charged." It is a linked-account offset, not a single 100% offset sub-account.

redrawAvailable.sourceTitle: SCCU Premium Variable Rate Home Loan TMD v6.0, issued 2 March 2026
redrawAvailable.note: Redraw available on variable loans. On fixed-rate loans the product page limits redraw/additional repayments to $10,000 per year.

constructionAvailable.sourceTitle: SCCU Premium Variable Rate Home Loan TMD v6.0, issued 2 March 2026
constructionAvailable.note: Permitted purposes include "Building and construction finance" and "Purchase of land".

guarantorAccepted.sourceTitle: SCCU Premium Variable Rate Home Loan TMD v6.0, issued 2 March 2026
guarantorAccepted.note: An acceptable guarantor is one of the three named alternatives to paying LMI (the others being LMI itself and the Australian Government 5% Deposit Scheme).

governmentSchemesSupported.sourceTitle: SCCU Premium Variable Rate Home Loan TMD v6.0, issued 2 March 2026
governmentSchemesSupported.note: Scheme loans are restricted to owner-occupier purposes, must be to buy or build a property the borrower will live in, and are offered on a principal-and-interest basis only outside of any construction period.

notes.value: SCCU is a customer-owned credit union formed in 1966 in the Tweed Valley (formerly Tweed Byron Credit Union), based in Murwillumbah with branches across northern NSW. Broker-distributed: the TMD's Third Parties channel permits accredited brokers where a legal agreement is in place and the broker holds appropriate authorisations and industry memberships; SCCU runs a broker portal. Borrowers may switch between principal-and-interest and interest-only subject to approval. Product range also includes a line of credit, a bridging loan and a reverse mortgage, each with its own TMD.
notes.sourceTitle: SCCU Premium Variable Rate Home Loan TMD v6.0, issued 2 March 2026
notes.note: Some third-party comparison sites state SCCU's advertised offers are not available on broker-introduced business — that could not be verified on any SCCU page and is NOT recorded as policy.

value.conditions: Must be an individual aged 18 or over with an Australian residential address.
Permanent resident of Australia, with an Australian residential address.
"New Zealand citizens can be considered under a mortgage secured basis only, but must be residing in Australia and declaring income to the ATO."

rules.sourceTitle: SCCU Premium Variable Rate Home Loan TMD v6.0, issued 2 March 2026 — Eligibility Criteria
rules.note: The TMD names only these three categories. It is silent on temporary work/student/partner visas, expats and non-residents — absence from the list is not recorded as a decline.

gaps: No servicing buffer, assessment floor rate, DTI cap, rent shading, HEM basis, credit-card assessment rate or commitment treatment published anywhere public.
No income-type policy: casual, contract, probation, overtime, bonus, commission, self-employed and Centrelink treatment are all unpublished.
No credit-history policy published (defaults, arrears, bankruptcy, enquiries).
The 'professionals list' driving the 90% LMI waiver is referenced but the actual occupation/institute list is not published.
No maximum loan amount published; the $250,000 minimum is a Financial-Situation statement in a TMD rather than a stated product minimum.
No security policy — no minimum unit size, postcode restrictions, high-density, rural or land-size rules published.
No genuine savings or gifted deposit policy published.
ACL and ABN not captured from the pages inspected.
Broker channel is confirmed by the TMD, but whether SCCU's advertised rates/offers are available on broker-introduced business could not be confirmed.
